name: handoff
description: Past a context size you set, at a good stopping point, moves the work to a fresh session with a handoff Claude writes.

handoffMode.title: Handoff mode
handoffMode.description: off logs a shadow baseline and acts on nothing. ask shows a band with buttons. act hands off or compacts without asking.

handoffContextTokens.title: Handoff context size (tokens)
handoffContextTokens.description: Context size past which a handoff is considered. A fresh session starts near 48,000 tokens.

compactBeforeClear.title: Compact the old session before clearing
compactBeforeClear.description: Costs one compaction per handoff. When on, claude --resume <old id> reopens the compacted transcript, not the full one.
